author: Linnéa R

text: A really good app to keep tabs on everything you have to do. The feature to assign a task to either your morning, afternoon, or evening is great and prevents you from feeling like you have everything to do at once. And that is accompanied by the wonderful feature which calculates what Morning, Afternoon, and Evening is for you depending on when you wake up and go to bed. Simply put, this app is a great way to organize your life without putting too much pressure on yourself.

text: Clean design with large text and buttons, no clutter. Free version has all required features I expect. any habit (good/bad) with any frequency (specific days, daily, weekly), a history with stats/streaks/calendar, and reminders. This is exactly what I was looking for, well done! UPDATE oct 2022: I suddenly got way more full screen ads, which beats the purpose of being able to quickly check off habits during a busy day. That along with the inability to turn off sounds sadly made me uninstall
author: Andreas Nilsson
developer_reply: Hi Nilsson, sorry to hear that. Our app is free to download and use, and the ad is a way to make everyone enjoy the app at NO COST. Besides, we will discuss and work on adding the feature of turning off the sounds to it. Thank you again and have a nice day. 😁
